name: MLIR
staging_note: Lane-scoped subtree stage, NOT a full llvm-project monorepo stage. Cloned via `git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse --depth 1` followed by `git sparse-checkout set mlir`, restricting the working tree to the `mlir/` subdirectory of the llvm-project monorepo at the pinned commit. After capturing the pinned commit SHA, the outer llvm-project top-level files/dirs (clang, lldb, etc.) were discarded and the inner `mlir/` subtree was flattened up one level, so this donor's root (`.atlas/temporary/donors/mlir/`) IS the `mlir/` subtree root directly (CMakeLists.txt, LICENSE.TXT, include/, lib/, test/, tools/, python/, ...), matching this repo's flat donor-staging convention (donor root = staged source root, no extra repo-name nesting). This donor is distinct from, and does not modify or duplicate, the pre-existing `llvm-project` donor (`.atlas/temporary/donors/llvm-project/`, full monorepo, pinned separately at commit 0bd330675f9eb08126e467505a0800f167084473) already staged for the compiler_backend/ir/optimizer/codegen lane. The `mlir` donor exists specifically for the ASIR (Atlas Semantic IR) design-education lane: dialect-definition mechanism, IR object model, bytecode, IRDL, pattern rewriting.
pin_policy: This exact commit SHA is the durable pin. The clone was a floating shallow clone of llvm-project's HEAD at clone time (depth 1, blob:none partial filter); the SHA recorded here, not any branch name, is the identity that must be used to re-derive or re-verify this donor's content.
license_evidence: Verified by reading .atlas/temporary/donors/mlir/LICENSE.TXT directly (the mlir/ subtree's own copy of the LLVM Project license file, byte-identical in content/header to the top-level llvm-project LICENSE.TXT): header text reads 'The LLVM Project is under the Apache License v2.0 with LLVM Exceptions', SPDX identifier confirmed from source file headers throughout the tree as 'Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception'.
not_a_runtime_dependency: Atlas does not and will not depend on MLIR/LLVM as a runtime or build dependency for ASIR. This stage exists purely for architecture-education census; any adoption is a clean-room Rust reimplementation of studied ideas, never copied C++ source.
